office: the Guyana Elections Commission (GECOM), at its registration offices

routes.label: registration at a GECOM registration office; the card ready within six weeks

note: GECOM's press release of 31 October 2023: a first-time registrant's card is produced no later than six weeks after applying (two weeks for a replacement or correction); a citizen 14 or older may register. The fee and the card's term aren't stated, so they're null and the player is told.

sources.title: Guyana Elections Commission, Registrants are Advised to Uplift their National Identification Cards (31 October 2023)
sources.said: an Identification Card would be produced at no later than six (6) weeks from the time of the application. ... any person who will be 14 years and older by the 31st December, 2023, and is a Guyanese citizen by birth, descent, naturalization, or registration
